nominal_coordinates.axis_authority: V151 prior-audit code identifies +Z72 five deck boards and -Z72 three bottom runners. This is source-asset anatomy evidence, not initializer-channel or semantic-label certification.
nominal_coordinates.projection: p_camera=R_m2c*p_model+t_m2c; (u,v)=first2(K*p_camera)/(K*p_camera)[2]. Preserve supplied R/t/K; camera_model=solve(R,-t), not an assumed exact transpose inverse.
nominal_coordinates.do_not_apply: The separate synthetic world-Z-up to model-Y-up transform is not an additional MR6D transform.

dynamic_role_rule.authority: Exact existing V74 pure rule as reused by V153. Empirically verified source-renderer-equivalent contract, not recovered historical writer code or certification of actual learned-channel physical correspondence.
dynamic_role_rule.front_selection: Outward face normals, camera direction from box center; argmax normalized dot product over four vertical faces only. No image-area rule, q-nearest rule, reference-error minimization or GT-best permutation.
dynamic_role_rule.front_order: Two highest model-Z vertices, image-X ascending gives top-left/top-right; corresponding same-model-XY bottom vertices give bottom-right/bottom-left.
dynamic_role_rule.rear_order: Opposite face is front_face_index XOR 1; retain each front vertex structural correspondence across box depth by nearest fixed 3D opposite vertex. Do not independently image-X-sort rear vertices.
dynamic_role_rule.permutation_direction: perm[dynamic_slot]=canonical_fixed_index; dynamic_reference[k]=canonical_reference[perm[k]]. Original inferred q[k] is never permuted again.
dynamic_role_rule.tie_status: V153 inherited exact_tie_original_writer_policy_uncertified flag (margin<=1e-10) remains an uncertainty flag. Listed-order tie breaking computes a reference but does not manufacture semantic identity. No new threshold tuning.
dynamic_role_rule.role_vs_visibility: Rear name or convex-box proxy does not determine self-hidden/external/visible semantic state.

selected_instance_contract.confirmed_from_code: Initializer selects first confidence argmax proposal, then transports raw first8 of9 keypoints unchanged. V153 projects every supplied obj1 GT list instance separately; it does not identify which GT instance the selected detection denotes.
not_identity_authority: selected detection index equal to GT-list index
nearest nominal corner or best permutation
selected_instance_contract.bbox_diagnostic: Frozen continuous bbox IoU against all GT object IDs may report identity candidates, ties, no overlap, invalid and other-object outcomes. It is weak correspondence evidence, not automatic exact semantic identity gold.
selected_instance_contract.foreign_relative_to_target: A different instance, including a second obj1 pallet of the same material, is foreign relative to the selected target. Provided full/visible masks may overlap and are not exclusive owner maps.
selected_instance_contract.unknown_preservation: Retain every original row and all GT candidates. Unresolved selected-instance correspondence stays UNKNOWN; it is not resolved by changing q/L, fitting pose or selecting the best-looking model result.

intended_material_part.minimum_definition: Once target-instance correspondence is explicit, map slot k through the fixed dynamic-to-canonical rule to a declared deck/runner end region on that selected source pallet. Use a fixed coarse material component/end patch and unchanged original crop.
intended_material_part.existing_gap: The reviewed nominal8 projection supplies box/endpoint references, not a released per-native selected material-part segmentation label or a q-to-GT-instance crosswalk. V180 constructive synthetic part IDs/quads are not MR6D mesh part IDs.
intended_material_part.allowed_practical_authority: A clearly supported RGB structural part/end witness may remain an explicitly weak source observation. Exact physical vertex/depth certification is not a new prerequisite for existing human semantic labels or such weak observations.
do_not_promote: a nominal projected point to <=3px physical gold

intended_material_part.q_shift: A shifted q can sample background or a different facet while the intended end remains visible nearby. Preserve q and supervise the original crop question; do not infer a coordinate correction.
